cover_letter.content:
At Example Analytics, I can contribute my background in machine learning and Python to the team for the Graduate Machine Learning Engineer position. My role as a Data Science Intern at Example Logistics equipped me with hands-on experience in both model training and real-world deployment.

During my internship, I developed and deployed an image classifier for leaf diseases using PyTorch, achieving 91% accuracy on a held-out set of 2,000 images. This project not only demonstrated my proficiency in model training but also showcased my ability to fine-tune models to meet specific requirements, which is crucial for your team’s work with PyTorch.

In another project, I built the Course Notes Assistant, a retrieval-augmented question answering app over lecture notes using Python and FastAPI. By indexing 400 pages of notes and integrating them with LangChain and FAISS, I was able to create an efficient information retrieval system that can answer questions with source links. This experience aligns well with the skills required for preparing data pipelines in Python and packaging models with Docker.

My work on a fine-tuned Hugging Face Transformers model to tag product reviews by sentiment demonstrated my capability to handle natural language processing tasks effectively. This project required proficiency in Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, which I applied using Python, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in tagging over 20,000 labeled reviews.

These skills and experiences will enable me to contribute meaningfully to Example Analytics’ mission of advancing machine learning applications. I look forward to the opportunity to mentor and be mentored as part of Example Analytics' structured programme for new engineers.

Thank you for considering my application. I am eager to discuss how my experience aligns with your needs further.
